name: signature-map
description: Lightweight code-declaration index for fast, low-token navigation: a Go generator builds signatures.json (types and callables with signatures, doc comments, and line numbers across Swift, Objective-C, C/C++, Kotlin, Java, JS/TS, Python, Ruby, and shell), and the sigmap CLI refreshes the index, queries declarations by name or regex, opens code around matches, and diagnoses index health.
